item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Manipur protests continue with thousands banging utensils, drums and horns against rising violence, while security forces fire tear gas at crowds in Kangla Fort and other towns. In Kashmir, a woman was killed after being hit by a scooter in Baramulla and a man died in a road accident on Rajouri Road, while a six-year-old boy was killed by a tractor in Tangmarg. The Kuki-Zo Women’s Forum has called for President's Rule in Manipur, describing the crisis as political rather than security related. Gaurav Gogoi has again questioned the Centre's response and demanded accountability. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
